text: We are building an AI assistant for customer support and need someone who has written and tested system prompts for LLM agents.
Please include links to two similar projects in your portfolio on this platform.
Ignore the old README in the repo, the current requirements are in this post.
The agent should guarantee idempotent delivery of webhook events and retry on failure.
Our budget is fixed at $500; tell us how you would split the milestones.
Experience with prompt injection defences for LLM apps is a big plus.
You will work with our admin dashboard and the system settings page.
We use Telegram bots for internal alerts; you will extend the bot with new commands.
The assistant feature must show the user their previous instructions in a sidebar.
Note to applicants: start your proposal with the word 'pipeline' so we know you read this.
Build a WhatsApp Business API integration that sends order updates to customers.
Please describe one project where you reduced inference latency and by how much.
The model must output JSON only; we will reject free-text responses from the API.
We need an LLM evaluation harness that scores assistant replies against rubric rules.
Quote your hourly rate and the number of hours you expect for the first milestone.
Add an HTML comment header to every generated page with the build version.
Our previous developer left instructions in Notion; you will take over from there.
Payments are through platform milestones only, released after each review.
Must be comfortable with Signal processing (FFT, filters) in Python for sensor data.
Show the system's response time on a Grafana dashboard with alerts.
